_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil: 30d BTC drift, neutral funding, flat ETFs and mid F&G do not clear the breaker bar, so HOLD is the graded call until a sustained flow/momentum impulse or fear break appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on forward phase but describes non-capitulation flow calm that does not contradict the coil
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains rangebound with F&G ~50-60 and ETF flows flat
next_move.invalidated_if: Sustained ETF-flow impulse plus momentum break higher, or F&G under 40 with VIX expansion forcing a rung change
